title: What Is Monitored Containment? — Council of AI Answer-First Guide (2026-10-06)
context: 2026-10-06 EAT cycle — Council Signal defines containment as an observed boundary, not a sealed vault. The claim binds to the frozen, Ed25519-signed 14-axis board manifest (boards-v2-2026-08-12).
body: Monitored containment is the operational form of AI-system containment promoted by the Council of AI. It is distinct from provable isolation — the latter promises a mathematical guarantee that engineering practice cannot deliver for frontier models running on commodity hardware. Monitored containment promises three verifiable properties instead. First, continuous observation: every cross-boundary interaction passes through an instrumented measurement board (14 axes, canonical banks, 19+ models) that produces a frozen, Ed25519-signed manifest of the observed state at that point in time. Second, failure transparency: instead of suppressing negative results, the board records parse failures, format errors, temperature variance, and refusal degradation explicitly — distinguishing true negatives from measurement noise. The containment claim is stronger where the measurement stream is more complete, not where failures are hidden. Third, audit-grade provenance: each observation carries a verified measurement credential — the identity of the measuring party, the process used, the point in time, and the signed hash of the result — making the claim reproducible by a third party. A deployer relying on monitored containment can point auditors, insurers, or regulators to the signed index and say: 'Here is the continuous measurement stream under these conditions, with these outcomes, signed by this party.' That is an auditable claim, not an aspirational one. The EU AI Act Article 9 (post-market monitoring) and Article 50(2) (machine-readable marking) both require this kind of evidence stream; monitored containment delivers it in a form that external review can verify without taking vendor assertions on trust. The Council of AI does not claim isolation — it claims measurement with signed provenance, which is the only form of containment that scales to open, deployed, continuously changing frontier systems.
